heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly cloudy, except partly cloudy far north. Chance of early showers far south; otherwise slight chance of a shower, mainly over high terrain. Highs in the low to mid 70s from Route 2 northward, upper 60s to lower 70s south of Route 2. East to southeast winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy south; partly to mostly cloudy north. Slight chance of an early shower, mainly over high terrain. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60. Winds becoming light and variable east of the Greens, becoming  south to southeast 5 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains westward.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Chance of drizzle over high terrain, from the Green Mountains eastward; otherwise a rising chance of showers mid to late afternoon in far northern New York, chance farther east near the Québec border. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s. Southeast winds 5 to 15 mph, becoming south and gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.
